listing.name: FTAPS Protocols
listing.summary: Hey there John Starsector! I'm Lightning Dog and I have one question and one question only!
listing.aiSummary: Disables the AI points balancing system to allow large AI cores on ships without readiness penalties.

description: Removes the restrictions imposed by the AI points system, allowing players to equip high-tier AI cores like Omega or Tesseract on any ship. This bypasses Quality Captains limits and other balance mechanics regarding AI usage.
